KeysToEntries.VICTORY_INFO: You made it back to Speranza!
KeysToEntries.DEFEAT_INFO: You didn't make it back home this time, Raider!
KeysToEntries.QUOTE01: "Thought I hit the jackpot. Turns out, I was the jackpot." - Unlucky Dan
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_SOUVENIR: "They clearly liked you and wanted a souvenir."
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_OPTIMISM: Your optimism in the face of empty pockets is your true superpower.
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_PRACTICEROUND: It’s fine. That was just a practice round.
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_SMOOTHRAIDS: “Smooth raids do not make skilled Raiders. But they do involve considerably fewer bullet holes.” - Celeste
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_COMEBACK: The universe is just setting you up for an epic comeback.
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_STILLTOCOME: Your moment to shine is still to come.
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_LUCKYSOCKS: Maybe you forgot your lucky socks in the wash?
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_RESILIENCE: Resilience pays off. Don’t let anyone tell you otherwise.
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_STATISTICALLY: “Statistically, street sweepers have a much lower chance of being shot in the face.” - Unemployed Former Raiders Association
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_CANTSMELLYOU: “ARC can’t smell you when you stand still. But they can still see you and shoot you, so...” - Old Man Ulysses
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_FRIEND_REQUEST_MESSAGE: A friend request will be sent to {0}
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_SIXOUTOFTEN: “Out of my current clients, seven out of ten of them are still around. Oh. Make that six out of ten.” - Velvet Veracity, Raider Guru
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_VILLAINARC: This would be the perfect start to your villain arc.
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_INSTYLE: At least you went out in style.
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_DUSTOFF: Dust yourself off, patch together a new gun, and get back out there.
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_LANCESPECIALTY: Fixing up Raiders like you is Lance’s speciality.
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_SHORTCAREER: “If I gave up every time I got shot, I would have had a very short career.” - Veteran Raider
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_ROLLAGAIN: “Sometimes the dice roll in your favor, and sometimes they don’t. Not much you can do besides roll them again.” - Bilguun
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_LAUNDRY: “If you have a child, don’t let them become a Raider. It is way too much laundry.” - Someone’s Mom
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_GOODFORBUSINESS: “Lots of Raider infighting going on. If nothing else, I guess it’s good for business.” - Tian Wen
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_PATIENTZERO: "I don't see the problem with eating surface plants, it's probably safe." - Timothy, patient zero for a new disease
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_BREATHE: “Breathe. Let your body settle into a slower rhythm.” - Meditation Tape
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_ONEARM: “We experimented with using ARC parts as full plate armor. Took one magnetic explosive for us to realize that was a mistake.” - Olaf One-Arm (formerly just Olaf)
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_UNDERDOG: The underdog always wins in the end. Keep going.
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_DONTGIVEUP: Doesn’t matter if you’re beaten down, bruised, or bloodied. Raiders don’t give up.
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_LEARNINGEXPERIENCE: Every failure is a learning experience.
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_SAFEPOCKET: And that’s why you have a Safe Pocket. Backup loot.
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_STICKWITHIT: “I can’t tell you how many times I came crawling back home with empty pockets. The trick is to stick with it.” - Veteran Raider
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_CRED_PARTIAL_CREDS_NOTICE: You’ve received partial Creds because you’ve reached the Cred limit during the round.
KeysToEntries.ID_EOR_CRED_NO_CREDS_NOTICE: You’ve reached the Cred limit. Spend Cred on Raider Deck rewards or Shani’s offers.
